abstract_sentences.text: Unsupervised reinforcement learning (URL) pre-trains agents by exploring diverse states in reward-free environments, aiming to enable efficient adaptation to various downstream tasks.

evidence.anchor: pre-trains agents by exploring diverse states

abstract_sentences.text: Without extrinsic rewards, prior methods rely on intrinsic objectives, but heterogeneous exploration data demand strong modeling capacity for both intrinsic reward design and policy learning.
abstract_sentences.comparison: prior methods versus heterogeneous replay data

evidence.anchor: heterogeneous exploration data demand strong modeling capacity

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce the Exploratory Diffusion Model (ExDM), which leverages the expressive power of diffusion models to fit diverse replay-buffer distributions, thus providing accurate density estimates and a score-based intrinsic reward that drives exploration into under-visited regions.
abstract_sentences.comparison: diffusion model versus prior intrinsic modeling

evidence.anchor: a score-based intrinsic reward that drives exploration

abstract_sentences.text: This mechanism substantially broadens state coverage and yields robust pre-trained policies.

Beyond exploration, ExDM offers theoretical guarantees and practical algorithms for fine-tuning diffusion policies under limited interactions, overcoming instability and computational overhead from multi-step sampling.

Extensive experiments on Maze2d and URLB show that ExDM achieves superior exploration and faster downstream adaptation, establishing new state-of-the-art results, particularly in environments with complex structure or cross-embodiment settings.
The source code is provided at https://github.com/yingchengyang/ExDM.

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 4.1 statement
equation_theory_inventory.description: 在离散 S/A 与随机 simplex 假设下，最大 state entropy 的可行分布以高概率为中心且 policy 非 deterministic。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 4.1 proof: convex-polytope reduction
equation_theory_inventory.description: 将 deterministic-policy state distributions 视作 convex polytope D 的顶点，并将 O∈D 转为均匀 simplex 点凸包事件。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Wendel Theorem dependency
equation_theory_inventory.description: 引用几何概率结果对 i.i.d. uniform simplex points 给出 Eq. (15)；这是外部基础，不是 ExDM 新 theorem。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 4.1 proof: simplex volume
equation_theory_inventory.description: 嵌套积分得到 vol(H)=√S/(S−1)!，对应 Eq. (16)。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 4.1 proof: intersection and convergence
equation_theory_inventory.description: 构造 C⊆(2O−H)∩H，结合 Eq. (17)–(18) 得 v(S)<1 与 A 增大时的概率收束。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 4.2 statement
equation_theory_inventory.description: 以 π_0=π_d、π_n∝π_d exp(Q_{n−1}/β)、Q_n=Q^{π_n} 交替更新，J_f 单调不降并收敛到 J_f 最优 policy。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 4.2 proof: variational policy
equation_theory_inventory.description: 定义 F 并用 calculus of variations 得 Eq. (23)–(25) 的 Boltzmann policy 与一次 policy improvement。

equation_theory_inventory.label: Theorem 4.2 proof: occupancy monotonicity
equation_theory_inventory.description: 用 Eq. (26)–(30) 与 discount occupancy identity 证明 J_f(π_n)≥J_f(π_{n−1})。

final_judgment.single_storyline: URL 的核心瓶颈被写成异质 replay-buffer state distribution 的密度拟合与 policy expression；ExDM 用 state diffusion 产生 R_score、用 Gaussian policy 低成本 acting，再用 KL-regularized alternating optimization 迁移 diffusion prior（p.4–6）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 保留 Theorem 4.1/4.2 statement、Eq. (6)–(14)、Algorithm 1–2、Figure 2–4、Table 1、三个实验问题与 100k/2M/100k budgets，足以判断 coverage/transfer/efficiency 的方向性证据。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix A–D 放置 proofs、IQL/CEP implementation、task semantics、全量 maze heatmaps、task-level rewards、160/80-run aggregate intervals、timestep ablation 与 compute；正文调用明确但若无附录则无法复核关键假设和分母。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 机制图 → Figure 2/Table 1 定性+定量 coverage → Figure 3 统一 aggregate transfer → Figure 4 预算/优化器/采样/β 消融，形成与方法两条 policy path 对应的证据顺序。
final_judgment.largest_gap: “up to 51%”未给相对分母；没有 R_score/state diffusion/policy-capacity matched ablation；Theorem 4.2 exact-Q guarantee 与近似 IQL/CEP 实现之间没有误差或收敛桥接。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 同时承担建模表达力和 online acting 的方法，应在正文显式分离两者，用机制图和 matched-time 对照固定因果边界，并把 aggregate 分母、区间与 task-level 数值放在可调用附录。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合 replay-model 与 online-control 双路径的 RL/generative-policy 工作；若结论依赖近似优化器、视觉输入或真实部署，还需增加 approximation-to-guarantee、输入模态和 failure-case 证据。
